TEAM.EYEBROW: People who guide and support children
TEAM.TITLE: The Limpicii team
TEAM.STORY: Everything we do at Limpicii begins with volunteering and the joy of being together. We are brought together by our love for children, the wish to give them wonderful experiences and the belief that a community grows stronger when everyone lends a hand. We encourage children to discover sport, believe in themselves and enjoy the little victories, whether they happen on the court, on a mountain trail or during a day outdoors. Nature is more than the setting for our adventures: we want to know it, respect it and care for it. We like to keep things simple, with plenty of energy, good cheer and room for the occasional joke. That is how we grow together - children, volunteers and community - one step at a time, with a smile.

CAMPS.TITLE: Camps with Limpicii
CAMPS.INTRO: Through sport and hiking, we shape real people!
CAMPS.DESCRIPTION: The camps organized by ACS LIMPICII Brașov are a defining tradition for our club. Each year, we hold a ski camp at Cabana Postăvaru in February, a seaside camp at Hotel Delta in Mamaia in June, a camp near the Râmeț Gorges at Casa Butnarului in Alba County in July, a major trip to one of the Carpathian mountain ranges in August, and a team-building camp at Cabana Diham in the Bucegi Mountains in September. These camps help children make progress in sport—for example, in skiing—grow more independent, especially during the major trip, and build lifelong friendships, particularly during the team-building camp at Cabana Diham. Every experience is designed to combine physical activity with personal growth.
CAMPS.DESCRIPTION_P1: Through daily training and outdoor activities, children significantly improve their fitness and develop the discipline that comes with sport. Beyond athletic technique, our camps are a real exercise in independence: children learn to manage their own schedules, equipment, and physical and mental well-being, with as little screen time and technology as possible.
CAMPS.DESCRIPTION_P2: The greatest benefit, however, is the way the group grows closer.
CAMPS.DESCRIPTION_P3: Spending time together day and night helps Limpicii children develop social skills and trust in one another, turning the group into a real team. Through everything we do, we offer children a safe, active and educational environment where every experience becomes a lasting memory and a lesson for the future.

ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_ONE: It all began in 1998, when a group of children prepared to take part in the 24-hour swimming marathon together. A playful blend of pici (‘little ones’) and olimpici (‘Olympians’) gave Limpicii their name.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_TWO: From the pool to the mountain trails, team spirit has remained at the heart of their story. In 2002, the group became a sports association, and its story continues with each new generation of children.
ABOUT.IMAGE_ALT: Limpicii club members together on a tennis court
ABOUT.CAPTION: Always a team.
ABOUT_US.TITLE: Sport, learning and community
ABOUT_US.INTRO: The association organizes physical and sporting activities for children and young people. Through movement, recreation and time outdoors, we encourage them to learn, build confidence and work together.
ABOUT_US.ACTIVITIES_TEXT: We organize sporting and recreational activities where children can discover new disciplines, practice their skills and enjoy spending time as a team. The program includes sports, hikes, trips and camps.
ABOUT_US.OBJECTIVE_THREE: Including children with physical disabilities in all activities
ABOUT_US.OBJECTIVE_FOUR: Improving, in every way, the facilities and equipment needed to carry out physical and sporting activities to the highest standard and with maximum safety
ABOUT_US.OBJECTIVE_FIVE: Ensuring adequate human resources and providing them with professional training in the spirit of teamwork
ABOUT_US.OBJECTIVE_SIX: Supporting and carrying out theoretical and practical activities that promote recreational sports tourism and hiking to discover the beauty of nature and protect the environment
ABOUT_US.OBJECTIVE_SEVEN: Developing and carrying out our own programs, as well as taking part in projects that align with the association’s purpose
ABOUT_US.OBJECTIVE_EIGHT: Organizing and carrying out any other activity compatible with the association’s purpose
ABOUT_US.COMMUNITY_TEXT: Sport brings children together and gives them opportunities to cooperate, support one another and take part. We aim to include children with physical disabilities in the association’s activities and encourage respect for nature through hiking and environmental education.
ABOUT_US.VALUE_ONE: Movement and healthy habits through sport.
ABOUT_US.VALUE_TWO: Inclusion, cooperation and activities where every child can take part.
ABOUT_US.VALUE_THREE: A connection with nature and care for the environment.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.EYEBROW: Sport brings us closer to our community
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.TITLE: Together, for more than sport
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.DESCRIPTION: At Limpicii, children learn that the joy of being active grows when it is shared. We run, cheer others on and take part in initiatives that bring people together.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.NOVEMBER_TITLE: Running together at the 15 November Marathon
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.NOVEMBER_DESCRIPTION: Every year, Limpicii take part in the marathon. For the children, every step is about courage, perseverance and the joy of representing their team.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.NOVEMBER_ALT: Limpicii children taking part in a team sports activity
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.NOVEMBER_BACKGROUND: The 15 November Cross in Brașov is a commemorative race dedicated to the anti-communist revolt of 15 November 1987. Its route recalls the workers’ march, and the event brings people of all ages together through running and remembrance. (Source: 15noiembrie.ro)
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.NOVEMBER_PARTICIPATION: Limpicii return to this race every year. The children run together, cheer on their teammates and represent the club with perseverance and joy. Each step is a chance to celebrate movement and community spirit.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BRASOV_MARATHON_TITLE: Cheering on runners at Brașov Marathon
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BRASOV_MARATHON_DESCRIP: Sometimes the best thing we can do is show up for others. Limpicii children come out to support the runners and lift their spirits along the course.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BRASOV_MARATHON_ALT: Limpicii members enjoying a sports experience together
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BRASOV_MARATHON_BACKGRO: Brașov Marathon brings runners to urban and mountain routes around Brașov in an event that celebrates movement and nature.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BRASOV_MARATHON_PARTICI: Limpicii support participants along the route. The children cheer runners on and share the atmosphere of an event open to the community.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BIMBO_TITLE: Running at Bimbo Marathon for a good cause
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BIMBO_DESCRIPTION: At the Bimbo Marathon by Lake Noua, a loaf of bread is donated to a child in need for every participant. We are happy to run and help make that possible.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BIMBO_ALT: Limpicii children taking part in an outdoor activity
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BIMBO_BACKGROUND: Bimbo Global Race is held across several countries and connects running with a food-support initiative for people in need.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.BIMBO_PARTICIPATION: Limpicii take part in the race at Lake Noua and contribute through their participation to the event’s donation initiative. Running becomes an act of solidarity for the children.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.RUNNERS_TITLE: Cheering on runners along the course
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.RUNNERS_DESCRIPTION: Limpicii children support participants with energy and encouragement, making the race a shared experience.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.RUNNERS_ALT: Limpicii members cheering on the runners
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.RUNNERS_BACKGROUND: At running events, support from the sidelines is part of the experience: a kind gesture or a few encouraging words can give runners a boost along the route.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.RUNNERS_PARTICIPATION: Limpicii children welcome and cheer on the runners. Their energy turns the race into a moment of connection and support between participants and the community.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.COMMUNITY_SUPPORT_TITLE: Supporting the community after a fire
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.COMMUNITY_SUPPORT_DESCR: We came together to help those affected, offering support and solidarity during a difficult time.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.COMMUNITY_SUPPORT_ALT: Community support effort following a fire
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.COMMUNITY_SUPPORT_BACKG: After a fire affected members of the community, people came together to offer help to those who needed it.
COMMUNITY_IMPACT.COMMUNITY_SUPPORT_PARTI: Limpicii joined the support effort, contributing help and solidarity. The action showed the children that caring for others also means taking action.

HISTORY.TITLE: The History of the Club
HISTORY.IMAGE_ALT: An image representing the history of Limpicii Club
HISTORY.PARAGRAPH_ONE: In 1998, as we were preparing to take part as a team in the 24-hour swimming marathon, we began looking for a name that represented us. We were PICI (little ones), but not OLIMPICI (Olympians), so everyone thought LIMPICILOR was the best—and funniest—choice. Our mascot was always by our side and brought us good luck. Through our yearly participation in the swimming marathon, Limpicii stood out for their team spirit, which helped them push beyond their limits.
HISTORY.PARAGRAPH_TWO: The same golden rule brings us together on mountain trails, where a misstep can often be dangerous. From the Tisa to the Danube, the Limpicii have explored the Carpathians, rediscovering the beauty of Romania’s landscapes each time. From the youngest to the oldest, everyone takes part in the group’s activities: hiking, skiing, swimming, tennis, roller skating, dancing and fitness. Though they are different ages, the Limpicii are one big family. Each member has a well-defined role and responsibilities, helping carry the group’s tradition forward.
HISTORY.ASSOCIATION_INTRO: Founded in 2002, the Limpicii Brașov Sports Club Association organizes, runs and manages physical and sporting activities to support the physical and moral education of young people.
HISTORY.OBJECTIVES_INTRO: The association’s objectives follow the provisions of Physical Education and Sport Law No. 69/2000 and Government Decision No. 884/2001, which approves the regulation implementing that law. The association aims to improve and maintain its members’ health by:
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_THREE: Including children with physical disabilities in all the activities we organize
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_FOUR: Improving the facilities and equipment needed to run physical and sporting activities effectively and as safely as possible
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_FIVE: Providing the human resources we need and training them in the spirit of teamwork
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_SIX: Supporting and running educational and practical activities that promote recreational sports tourism, hiking to discover the beauty of nature, and environmental protection
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_SEVEN: Developing and running our own programs and taking part in projects that support the association’s purpose
HISTORY.OBJECTIVE_EIGHT: Organizing and running any other activities that are compatible with the association’s purpose
HISTORY.PROGRAM: The sports program is set weekly. From Monday to Friday, group activities such as tennis and fitness are scheduled around the children’s school hours. On Saturdays and Sundays, the whole group takes part in activities such as trips, skiing and swimming. During school holidays, the regular program becomes more intensive and includes traditional camps: a winter ski camp, a seaside camp, a four- or five-day mountain trip, shorter two- or three-day trips, and cultural tour trips.
HISTORY.AFFILIATION: Since 2012, the Limpicii Brașov Sports Club Association has been affiliated with the Romanian Tennis Federation (FRT). Its athletes compete in FRT-sanctioned tournaments, and since 2015 the association has organized the Brașov Junior Tennis Championship, part of the FRT National Circuit, which brings together more than 100 children from across Romania each year.
